name: Fukami Natsuhiko
source:
Natsuhiko is a rising star in the world of horror writing.
He is passionate about mysterious tales, and his eyes sparkle with excitement whenever he hears a spine-chilling story. 
Natsuhiko has a gentle, introverted personality, which makes it challenging for him to connect with people his age, leaving him with few friends. 
Despite being good-looking, he remains inexplicably unpopular with the opposite sex.
